import random
import pygame
from config import CELL, COLS, ROWS, HUD, WIDTH, HEIGHT, SPEEDS, COLORS


class Snake:
    def __init__(self):
        cx, cy = COLS // 2, ROWS // 2
        self.body = [(cx, cy), (cx - 1, cy), (cx - 2, cy)]
        self.direction = (1, 0)
        self.queue = []

    def turn(self, d):
        last = self.queue[-1] if self.queue else self.direction
        if d != last and (d[0] + last[0], d[1] + last[1]) != (0, 0) and len(self.queue) < 2:
            self.queue.append(d)

    def __init__(self):
        pygame.init()
        self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
        pygame.display.set_caption("Snake")
        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()
        self.font = pygame.font.SysFont("consolas", 18)
        self.big = pygame.font.SysFont("consolas", 30, bold=True)
        self.state = "menu"
        self.difficulty = "Medium"
        self.reset()

    def reset(self):
        self.snake = Snake()
        self.score = 0
        self.won = False
        self.spawn_food()

    def start(self):
        self.reset()
        self.state = "play"

    def spawn_food(self):
        free = [(x, y) for x in range(COLS) for y in range(ROWS)
                if (x, y) not in self.snake.body]
        self.food = random.choice(free) if free else None

    def handle_input(self):
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                return False
            if event.type != pygame.KEYDOWN:
                continue
            if self.state == "menu":
                if event.key in (pygame.K_1, pygame.K_KP1):
                    self.difficulty = "Easy"
                    self.start()
                elif event.key in (pygame.K_2, pygame.K_KP2):
                    self.difficulty = "Medium"
                    self.start()
                elif event.key in (pygame.K_3, pygame.K_KP3):
                    self.difficulty = "Hard"
                    self.start()
                elif event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                    return False
            elif self.state == "play":
                d = {pygame.K_UP: (0, -1), pygame.K_w: (0, -1),
                     pygame.K_DOWN: (0, 1), pygame.K_s: (0, 1),
                     pygame.K_LEFT: (-1, 0), pygame.K_a: (-1, 0),
                     pygame.K_RIGHT: (1, 0), pygame.K_d: (1, 0)}.get(event.key)
                if d:
                    self.snake.turn(d)
                elif event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                    self.state = "menu"
            else:
                if event.key == pygame.K_r:
                    self.start()
                elif event.key == pygame.K_m:
                    self.state = "menu"
                elif event.key == pygame.K_q:
                    return False
        return True

    def update(self):
        if self.state != "play":
            return
        s = self.snake
        if s.queue:
            s.direction = s.queue.pop(0)
        hx, hy = s.body[0]
        head = (hx + s.direction[0], hy + s.direction[1])
        if not (0 <= head[0] < COLS and 0 <= head[1] < ROWS):
            self.state = "over"
            return
        eating = head == self.food
        if head in (s.body if eating else s.body[:-1]):
            self.state = "over"
            return
        s.body.insert(0, head)
        if eating:
            self.score += 1
            self.spawn_food()
            if self.food is None:
                self.won = True
                self.state = "over"
        else:
            s.body.pop()

    def draw(self):
        self.screen.fill(COLORS["bg"])
        for x in range(0, WIDTH, CELL):
            pygame.draw.line(self.screen, COLORS["grid"], (x, 0), (x, ROWS * CELL))
        for y in range(0, ROWS * CELL, CELL):
            pygame.draw.line(self.screen, COLORS["grid"], (0, y), (WIDTH, y))
        if self.food:
            pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, COLORS["food"],
                             (self.food[0] * CELL + 3, self.food[1] * CELL + 3,
                              CELL - 6, CELL - 6), border_radius=5)
        for i, (x, y) in enumerate(self.snake.body):
            color = COLORS["head"] if i == 0 else COLORS["snake"]
            pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, color,
                             (x * CELL + 1, y * CELL + 1, CELL - 2, CELL - 2),
                             border_radius=4)
        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, COLORS["hud"], (0, ROWS * CELL, WIDTH, HUD))
        hud = self.font.render(
            f"Score: {self.score}    Difficulty: {self.difficulty}    Arrows/WASD move - ESC menu",
            True, COLORS["text"])
        self.screen.blit(hud, (10, ROWS * CELL + 11))
        if self.state == "menu":
            self.overlay(["SNAKE", "Select difficulty:", "1 - Easy", "2 - Medium",
                          "3 - Hard", "ESC - Quit"])
        elif self.state == "over":
            title = "YOU WIN!" if self.won else "GAME OVER"
            self.overlay([f"{title}   Score: {self.score}",
                          "R - Restart    M - Menu    Q - Quit"])
        pygame.display.flip()

    def overlay(self, lines):
        veil = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, ROWS * CELL), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        veil.fill((0, 0, 0, 170))
        self.screen.blit(veil, (0, 0))
        y = ROWS * CELL // 2 - len(lines) * 24
        for line in lines:
            f = self.big if line == "SNAKE" or line.startswith(("GAME OVER", "YOU WIN")) else self.font
            text = f.render(line, True, COLORS["text"])
            self.screen.blit(text, (WIDTH // 2 - text.get_width() // 2, y))
            y += 44 if f is self.big else 28

    def run(self):
        running = True
        while running:
            running = self.handle_input()
            self.update()
            self.draw()
            self.clock.tick(SPEEDS[self.difficulty] if self.state == "play" else 30)
        pygame.quit()
